title: Further projects with Getz and Manny Albam
summary: Sauter will not do another; Albam wrote for Getz.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis

blocks.x: Yeah, that's what he still tells me. He wants me to do some thing else, and I just can't. I didn't want to do it a fourth time--I didn't even want to do it a third time where you write the stuff and then play over it. He wants me to do something again, and quite frankly I don't know what to do at this point. Maybe I should just go ahead and do some- thing, I don't know, but it would necessarily be similar. Sometimes it's better to leave well enough alone.
Manny Albam did some things for him.
A few years ago I heard a tape that Stan had done with the Eastman Studio Orchestra where he went out to one of the arrangers' holidays, which as you know Manny
has been involved in for a long time, so Manny did some things for him, and they were quite nice.
This was for full string section plus, I guess, brass and woodwinds as well and a rhythm section.
I can't think of anybody else.
He did Girl From Ipanema on that Boston Pops thing, Manny did that.
